candidates.candidate_execution_model_evidence: A Generator/JIT program executes C++ or Python host code to construct and schedule a pipeline. It is not a declarative data file parsed solely by a trusted frontend.
candidates.host_scheduler_ownership: The candidate owns Halide algorithm and schedule primitives (including GPU block/thread mapping, tiling, vectorization and storage scheduling). build_artifacts.serialization_boundary: AOT host artifacts can contain embedded MSL bytes or MTLB-magic metallib bytes; live library/pipeline handles remain runtime state and are not candidate-bundle identities.

device_execution_path.frontend_to_binary: CodeGen_Metal_Dev lowers GPU loops and emits MSL. compile_to_src can instead invoke configured Metal compiler/linker commands and embed the resulting metallib bytes.
device_execution_path.library_load: halide_metal_initialize_kernels distinguishes MTLB magic and calls newLibraryWithData for a precompiled metallib or newLibraryWithSource for embedded MSL, then creates pipeline states.
device_execution_path.dispatch: halide_metal_run receives real blocksX/Y/Z and threadsX/Y/Z, binds buffers, dispatches threadgroups, ends encoding and commits a command buffer with a completion handler; halide_metal_device_sync can commit and waitUntilCompleted.
device_execution_path.external_execution_boundary: The stock runtime owns its queue and command buffers. A ShapeForge slice must therefore use the independent Halide frontend/AOT artifact path while binding execution into the shared ShapeForge substrate; calling the stock Halide runtime as an unmeasured black box is not acceptable.

candidates.worker_isolation_requirements: A separately evidenced OS-level sandbox for candidate generator compilation/execution and native loading, with no network or credentials, temporary HOME/cache, a write-set allowlist and bounded child processes. The current bounded worker does not supply that proof.
candidates.cache_lifecycle_requirements: Freeze Halide/LLVM/compiler options and AOT outputs in Build; bind generated MSL/AIR/metallib and host artifacts before execution; audit Halide's library/pipeline compilation cache; do not hide generator or input-dependent scheduling work in warmup.

independence_evidence.frontend: Halide has a real algorithm/schedule IR, inference/lowering and AOT/JIT compiler with CodeGen_Metal_Dev; it is not an MSL macro or a renamed frontend.
independence_evidence.optimizer_scheduler: Halide schedules control block/thread decomposition and memory/vector scheduling independently of ShapeForge's GeometryPair and HostTilingPlan.
independence_evidence.delivery_identity: A future slice would bind generator source, Halide/LLVM identity, schedule and generated host/device artifacts in a separate Track identity. MSL/AIR/metallib are backend outputs, not the candidate DSL.
independence_evidence.shared_substrate_boundary: Only the Metal safety/timing/evidence substrate would be shared. The existing MSL Track contract, HostTilingPlan, source combiner, geometry resolver and Track adapter must not become the Halide frontend.
